variants.title: Efficiency of a GM counter for gamma rays
variants.sample: Cs-137 gamma source, 37 kBq certificate, in a Perspex cap that stops its betas
variants.unknown: the intrinsic efficiency of the GM tube for 662 keV gamma rays
variants.note: Only about 1 % of the gamma rays crossing the tube are counted: a gamma must first eject an electron from the wall. 0.851 gamma per decay (NNDC, from memory - verify); the activity and the intrinsic efficiency are illustrative values of this source and tube; the slight absorption of the gammas in the Perspex cap is neglected.
